doc: Hook surface of other authors' mods. 2026-11-16 user decision: old-version transcriptions (FogTrial 1.7, Batteki 1.8/1.8.7, Yuga 1.1, R1 integrated-patch modules recorded at the 1fbe6be7 build) are discarded - only current-version sources count. To be rebuilt from reference_mod/san14ce-integrated-patch (current source) and the SAN14CE mod pack 2.4 (Batteki 1.9, Fog 1.7, Yuga 1.2); the 4계절 patch is ours (ModPack port) and is not listed. Schema 2: 'rva' is {build: RVA hex} for the current build only; mods.<id>.detect: any-of installer rules (file / ini [section] key != 0 / dir). kind: vt, call, bytes, com, entry_fingerprint. tools/hook_map.py R5 uses fingerprints, R7 the rest; relations say what our owner does about each overlapping mod.
